_about: Every data source in the Wait Watcher kitchen, in the order run_all.py runs them. Each script updates its own last_fetched, first_period and last_period. Fields: cadence (how often it's published), lag (how long after the period ends), grain (what one row describes), join_key (how it links to other sources), licence, status.

sources.name: rtt
sources.title: Referral to treatment (RTT) waiting times
sources.cadence: monthly (second Thursday, about six weeks after the month ends)

sources.name: ods
sources.title: Organisation Data Service: trusts, sites and independent providers

sources.name: cqc
sources.title: CQC care directory and latest ratings
sources.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (contains CQC information)
sources.join_key: ODS provider code / CQC provider ID

sources.name: fft
sources.title: Friends and Family Test: inpatient, outpatient and A&E

sources.name: staff_survey
sources.title: NHS Staff Survey: organisational results
sources.publisher: NHS England (NHS Staff Survey Coordination Centre)

sources.name: njr
sources.title: National Joint Registry: hip and knee replacements by hospital
sources.licence: No open licence found (Copyright NJR; data by request under a Data Sharing Agreement)
sources.reason: Not ingested: no open re-use licence is published. The hospital profiles are marked 'Copyright NJR', and data beyond the public reports needs an NJR Data Request Form, a signed Data Sharing Agreement and cost recovery.

sources.name: ers
sources.title: NHS e-Referral Service (e-RS): referrals and appointment slot issues
sources.note: Management information. ASI rate = ASIs per directly bookable service booking (can exceed 100%). Referral counts by provider aren't openly published.

sources.name: wlmds
sources.title: Waiting List Minimum Data Set (WLMDS): weekly waiting list
sources.grain: national by week; national by treatment function (latest week); provider (one snapshot a month)
sources.note: Weekly management information from patient-level submissions. Differs from monthly RTT: not quality assured, not every provider submits every week, includes pathways with an unknown start, no adjustment for non-submitters (except one estimate for the latest week). Monthly RTT stays the official count. Provider figures are one snapshot a month (each file's last week); there's no open provider-by-treatment table.

sources.name: cancer
sources.title: Cancer waiting times: 28-day, 31-day and 62-day standards
sources.grain: trust x standard (FDS, 31D, 62D); trust x standard x cancer type
sources.note: Standards: FDS 75% (28 days to diagnosis or all-clear), 31D 96%, 62D 85%. Latest months are provisional and revised in the next year's Final file.

sources.name: gpad
sources.title: Appointments in General Practice (GPAD)
sources.note: Booking-to-appointment time is not the same as how long a patient waited from first asking: it starts when the appointment is booked. Management information from GP systems; some practices map appointments differently.

sources.name: gp_practices
sources.title: GP practice lookup (ODS epraccur) with coordinates
sources.join_key: GP practice code; sub-ICB code; local authority name

sources.name: gpps
sources.title: GP Patient Survey
sources.reason: the GP Patient Survey site (Ipsos, '© GP Patient Survey') doesn't state an open licence for the practice data. OGL is likely via NHS England but isn't stated - confirm with GPPatientSurvey@ipsos.com before ingesting.

sources.name: talking_therapies
sources.title: NHS Talking Therapies monthly statistics
sources.join_key: ODS provider code (3 characters for trusts, 5 for other providers)
sources.note: 6- and 18-week figures are for people who finished a course of treatment that month (the national standard is 75% and 95%). Small numbers are suppressed; sub-national percentages are whole numbers. The second-appointment wait is the latest month only.

sources.name: mhsds
sources.title: Mental Health Services Monthly Statistics (MHSDS): referral to first contact
sources.note: CYP: referral to first contact. Adults (community mental health, serious mental illness): referral to SECOND contact - adult first-contact waits aren't published by provider. Median and 90th percentile are 3-month rolling. Referral-spell method changed Nov 2024. No referral spells file for 2025-01.

sources.name: community
sources.title: Community health services waiting lists
sources.grain: provider x service; ICB; region; England
sources.note: Unvalidated management information (community health services SitRep). Only counts by wait band, no medians. A blank is no submission, not zero. Safeguarding and looked-after children lines are national only. Non-submitters each month are in non_submitters.csv.

sources.name: ae
sources.title: A&E attendances and emergency admissions
sources.note: Four-hour standard 95%, interim aim 78% by March 2026. 12-hour figures here are from decision to admit, not arrival. Months are revised; revised files are re-downloaded.

sources.name: ambulance
sources.title: Ambulance Quality Indicators: response times
sources.join_key: ambulance trust ODS code; region code (Y56-Y63)
sources.note: Standards: C1 mean 7 min / 90th 15 min; C2 mean 18 min (interim 30) / 90th 40 min. Earlier months are revised each month. 90th centiles can't be added up across trusts.

sources.name: uec_sitreps
sources.title: Urgent and emergency care daily situation reports (winter)
sources.note: Winter only (about December to March), published weekly on Thursdays. Unvalidated management information. 2026-27 not yet published (expected early December 2026).

sources.name: workforce
sources.title: NHS workforce: vacancies / staffing by trust
sources.lag: vacancies about 2 months; sickness about 3 months
sources.grain: vacancies: region x sector; sickness: trust
sources.note: Vacancy rates are only published by region and sector (quarterly, experimental statistics; latest quarter 2026-06). Trust-level vacancies aren't open, so sickness absence by trust (monthly, about 4 months behind) is the trust-level staffing measure.

sources.name: fingertips
sources.title: Fingertips (OHID) area indicators
sources.publisher: Office for Health Improvement and Disparities
sources.join_key: ONS area code (E54..., E06/E08/E09/E10); ICB ODS code
sources.note: Latest period per indicator: deprivation_score_imd2025 2025; pct_aged_65_plus 2024; healthy_life_expectancy_birth 2022 - 24; healthy_life_expectancy_65 2022 - 24. ICB geography is the pre-2026 42 ICBs.

sources.name: population
sources.title: ONS population estimates
sources.lag: about 15 months (local authorities); longer for ICBs
sources.join_key: ONS area code; sub-ICB ODS code
sources.note: Local authorities: Mid-2025. ICBs: Mid-2024 ICB 2024 (April 2024 boundaries, 42 ICBs). Annual; LA and ICB editions don't reconcile exactly (LA figures were revised Oct 2026).

sources.name: dental
sources.title: NHSBSA dental activity
sources.note: Contract-level activity, not waits: NHS dentistry has no waiting list. 'Seen' counts are rolling (children 12 months, adults 24 months). Commissioner codes follow the ICB changes of the time.

sources.name: phin
sources.title: Private Healthcare Information Network (PHIN)
sources.reason: PHIN's terms allow only private, research, study or non-commercial use and forbid making content available on a network without PHIN's prior written consent. Not an open licence; ask PHIN for written consent before ingesting.

sources.name: uk_nations
sources.title: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland waiting times (headline)
sources.cadence: Scotland and Wales monthly; Northern Ireland quarterly
sources.note: NOT COMPARABLE with England: different standards (12 / 26 / 9-13 weeks), stage-of-treatment vs pathway counting, different cadence. Context only.

sources.name: clinicaltrials
sources.title: ClinicalTrials.gov (UK sites)
sources.cadence: daily; refreshed weekly here (full fetch every 28 days)
sources.join_key: NCT ID; ISRCTN and IRAS numbers; site postcode
sources.licence: ClinicalTrials.gov terms and conditions (free use; attribute ClinicalTrials.gov, keep current, show the processing date, state modifications)
sources.note: Attribution: 'Source: ClinicalTrials.gov, processed <date>; reshaped by Wait Watcher (UK sites only, contact details removed)'. Contact names, emails and phones are dropped at fetch time. Weekly: updates since the last run; full fetch every 28 days.

sources.name: isrctn
sources.title: ISRCTN registry (UK studies)
sources.licence: CC BY (ISRCTN FAQ: study details usable under a CC-BY licence)
sources.note: Attribution: 'Contains information from the ISRCTN registry, licensed CC BY'. Contacts and free-text protocol numbers are never stored. Status is worked out from recruitment dates, as on the ISRCTN site.

sources.name: trials
sources.title: UK clinical studies, de-duplicated, with sites matched to providers
sources.join_key: study_id; ODS provider and site codes; treatment function
sources.licence: ClinicalTrials.gov terms; ISRCTN CC BY (see those sources)
sources.note: Records linked by shared ISRCTN, IRAS or NCT number. Site matching never guesses: override, exact name+postcode, single-trust postcode, then a close name in the same town.

sources.name: nihr_activity
sources.title: NIHR research activity league table
sources.lag: a few months after the financial year
sources.reason: no open licence found (NIHR's site shows only '© NIHR'; on 21 Oct 2026 nihr.ac.uk couldn't be reached at all); no trust-level file found: the research activity league table hasn't been published since 2018/19; RDN portfolio data is by region and specialty only, and trust-level figures are only in NIHR's interactive Open Data Platform. Ask NIHR (RDN) for trust-level activity under the OGL.

sources.name: hra_summaries
sources.title: HRA research summaries
sources.reason: HRA copyright: free reproduction only 'for research or private study', not systematically reproduced for commercial gain - not the OGL or equivalent; no API or bulk download (~68,600 pages). Ask the HRA about OGL re-use before ingesting.

sources.name: bepartofresearch
sources.title: Be Part of Research (links only)
sources.licence: linking permitted (site terms); no content copied
sources.note: No public-ID URL for study pages; a search link per study ID is used instead.
